queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       avg_per_day_price,
       avg_per_day_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) FROM r) AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM r;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       price_per_day,
       price_per_day / (SELECT AVG(price_per_day) FROM r) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM r;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         SUM(rental_rate) * 1.0 / SUM(rental_duration) AS price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       price_per_day,
       price_per_day / (SELECT AVG(price_per_day) FROM r) AS ratio_to_avg
FROM r;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.rating,
         AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
         AVG(f.rental_rate * 1.0 / f.rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
)
SELECT rating,
       avg_replacement_cost,
       avg_rental_price_per_day,
       avg_rental_price_per_day / (SELECT AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) FROM r) AS ratio_to_overall_avg
FROM r;
